class.name: WeatherSkyMaterial
class.brief_description: The weather sky with clouds, ready to pick as a [Sky]'s material.
class.description: A [ShaderMaterial] with the built-in weather sky shader ([code]res://.builtin/weather_sky.gdshader[/code]) and its cloud noise textures already set. In the Inspector, pick [b]New WeatherSkyMaterial[/b] in [member Sky.sky_material]. A [Weather] node's [WeatherSkyEffect] drives this material directly: cloud coverage, overcast, cloud drift and lightning follow the weather. Without a [Weather] node it is a still, partly cloudy sky. The sky, cloud and colour parameters can be edited like any shader parameter. Saved materials refer to the shader by its path, so they use the current version of the built-in shader.
